fixtures.attack: Two source releases share one canonical source/wave alias and are assigned one universe_id.
Identical respondent key strings in distinct universes are treated as the same person without linkage authority.
Native question/version/component identity is dropped after canonical mapping.
Two repeated response events with identical respondent/question/value are deduplicated.
Unordered multiselect components are collapsed to one scalar or concatenated value without component identity.
Ranked response semantics rely on file/row order rather than explicit semantic ordinal.
A respondent has no response row and ingest silently interprets this as NOT_ASKED.
A risk set is replaced by another respondent set with the same denominator.
Carrier accepts only currently enumerated V550 indicator fields and drops a lawful source coordinate outside that list.
An empirical demographic coordinate is mapped directly to a nine-stratum generated structural position during ingest.
Missing/invalid governed weight is replaced by 1.0 without authority.
Question, topology, routing, weight, or crosswalk semantics dereference a mutable latest/default authority.
Two universes with a shared canonical label/harmonization lineage are pooled without separate pooling authority.
A retained empirical fact has support values but lacks exact predicate AST/hash, risk set, target, scope, or measure basis.
Actor comparator uses nearest geography/band/default time because exact comparator authority is missing.
A discovery result preserves only branch label/support and not exact candidate frontier, algorithm, predicate, coverage/pruning, and replay identity.
An empirical association is treated as StructuralEmpiricalAdmission without exact structural-admission authority.
Zero eligible/support denominator and observed zero outcome inside positive support are represented by one state.
A serialized artifact SHA is used as proof of semantic equivalence although proof-relevant fields are excluded from the semantic projection.
Respondent events are physically present and queryable before mandatory routing, authority, source-relation, or replay closure is sealed.
Current Postgres/shared V550 surface is declared C11-equivalent because columns/counts or selected aggregates match.
Successful logical C11 ingest is treated as authority to delete the original/source-native snapshot.

success_condition: A future executable C11 implementation must reject or type-block every hostile case without fallback, repair, source collapse, semantic promotion, or loss of M01-M18 replay information.
